Economics BSc at University of Warwick

What University of Warwick asks of applicants to Economics BSc for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Warwick courses · Economics & Finance field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 2 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma: A-level offers are met through AP tests, not the SAT/ACT
  • ACT composite 28 or 29 (depending on the course) or SAT 1340/1600 with no less than 540 in any section can meet the GCSE English and Mathematics/Science requirement

Warwick states its US entry requirements are under review for the 2027/28 cycle and should be used as a guide only.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Warwick: USA Entry Requirements
English language
  • English language Band C (stated on the 2027-entry course page)
  • IELTS Academic: 7.0 overall with at least 6.5 in each component
  • TOEFL iBT: 100 with at least 21 Listening, 21 Writing, 22 Reading, 23 Speaking (tests from 21 January 2026: 5.0 overall, at least 4.5 in each component)
  • PTE Academic: 75 with no less than 59 in any communicative skill

The band (C) is confirmed for 2027 entry on the course page; the test scores come from Warwick’s English Language Requirements page, which states them for September 2026 entry only (last updated 04 February 2026). 2027-entry scores not yet confirmed.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Warwick: Economics BSc · Warwick: English Language Requirements
Admissions tests
  • TMUA — optional (encouraged); applicants with the highest TMUA scores will be considered for a reduced AAA offer
  • Applicants without TMUA are still considered; TMUA is not used for contextual-offer applicants

Official (2027 entry): TMUA optional; high scorers considered for a reduced AAA offer. Warwick’s admissions-tests page says the Economics TMUA requirements are under review for 2027 entry.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Warwick: Economics BSc · Warwick: Admissions Tests (TMUA)
Subject prerequisites
  • Required: A-level Mathematics (or equivalent)
  • Further Maths and Economics: accepted, but no special status

Other qualifications
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma (no specific GPA required): A*AA is typically met with AP tests at 5, 5, 5, 5 in separate subjects, taken over a maximum of three years
  • Mathematics requirement: AP Calculus BC at grade 5 (AP Calculus AB not acceptable)
